info.name: Weak Content Security Policy - Detect
author: pussycat0x
celbahraoui
info.description: Detected misconfigured CSP directives containing unsafe and overly permissive keywords that weakened resource loading restrictions. This configuration allowed high-risk script behaviors, resulting in reduced protection against XSS attacks.

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/42.0.2311.135 Safari/537.36 Edge/12.10240
Connection: close
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' *.vendor.example
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 02:55:51 GMT
Server: nginx

<html><head><title>Example</title></head><body>Example Domain</body></html>
